resolution.root_cause: Power supply unit degraded or powered off on switch module
remediation_steps: Inspect physical switch power module indicator LEDs
Replace failed PSU unit or reconnect power feed
citations_and_reasons: Hardware manual section 4.2: Redundant PSU Operations

remediation_steps: Purge expired scratch directories and temporary dumps
Expand volume quota or allocate additional storage domains
citations_and_reasons: LANL Storage Architecture Guide: Sec 8.3 Filesystem Quotas

resolution.root_cause: Severe filesystem metadata inconsistency or I/O barrier timeout
remediation_steps: Quarantine and unmount the affected storage domain immediately
Restore corrupted metadata from snapshot if unrecoverable
citations_and_reasons: LANL Storage Architecture Guide: Sec 8.1 Panic Recovery

pattern: (?:interface alt0 is down|Component \S*alt0\S* is in the unavailable state)

resolution.root_cause: Physical network link loss or transceiver failure on alt0
remediation_steps: Verify physical Ethernet/InfiniBand patch cord and switch port
Restart interface via `ifconfig alt0 down && ifconfig alt0 up`
Reseat optical transceiver if link does not recover
citations_and_reasons: LANL Unix Hardware Runbook: Sec 3.1 Interface Diagnostics

pattern: failed to configure resourcemgmt subsystem err = 10

resolution.root_cause: Subsystem configuration error code 10 during daemon startup
remediation_steps: Check node controller connectivity and verify daemon configuration file
citations_and_reasons: LANL Resource Management Architecture Manual: Sec 5.2
